description: Animation bake-off, Sunburst side. Set defaults.style to the chosen direction first. Step 1: --only char- creates the test character from the pose template; save the best one as art/chars/mechanic.png. Step 2: --only posed- paints the character onto the skeleton pose sheets from tools/poses.py (method C, motion designed by us); --only sheet- lets the model invent the motion itself (method A). Process any result with: python3 tools/sprites.py sheet <png> --grid 4x2 --name <name>

jobs.subject: A survivor character for the game, full body, standing: a middle-aged train mechanic in a padded, patched work coat, a fur-lined cap with goggles pushed up, a thick knitted scarf, heavy gloves and boots, a big wrench hanging from the belt. Tired but kind face, a little stubble, breath slightly visible in the cold.
A smooth, natural 8-frame looping WALK cycle of this character (contact, down, passing, up — for each leg), arms swinging opposite to the legs, a slight up-and-down bob.
A smooth 8-frame looping WORK animation of this character standing in place: tightening a large bolt in front of them with the big wrench — wind up, push hard, pull back, repeat.
An 8-frame looping walk cycle of this character.

An 8-frame looping work animation: the character tightens a bolt with a big wrench held in both hands. The gray bar with a round end in the guide is the wrench, its jaw gripping the bolt: draw it as a heavy, worn steel wrench.
